entities.summary: Başakşehir Çam and Sakura City Hospital, also known as Başakşehir City Hospital, is a large district general hospital in Başakşehir district of Istanbul, Turkey. It was developed jointly by Turkish and Japanese cooperation, symbolized in the name with Çam ve Sakura. The hospital complex opened in May 2020.
